leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of search result data
Implement React state hooks to manage the search query and results
Utilize the useEffect hook to trigger side effects when the query changes
Construct a debounce function to delay API calls and prevent excessive requests
Use setTimeout and clearTimeout to control the timing of function execution
Handle input change events to update the search query state
Define a fetch function to retrieve search results from an API endpoint
Apply conditional rendering to display loading states and search results
Modify component cleanup to clear pending timeouts and prevent memory leaks
Return structured JSX with input fields and result lists for the search interface
